What this does and doesn’t give you

The entropy travels over TLS. For keys that never cross the network, see the Qrypt SDK.

The portal showed you different sample code?

The portal sample uses the eaas-aws API. This quickstart uses api-eus.

Keep the key safe

Don't print, log or commit your key, and don't reuse entropy bytes.
